exposure: Adherence to Enhanced Recovery after Cesarean Delivery (ERAC) standards
Adherence to Society of Anesthesiology and Perinatology (SOAP) standards
outcome: Implementation of perioperative obstetric care services
finding: The study found that while certain aspects of perioperative care, such as antibiotic prophylaxis and neonatal resuscitation preparedness, were fully implemented, the overall adherence to ERAC and SOAP standards was suboptimal, indicating a need for improvement.
